children: Rent the Runway announced a September 25, 2026 record date for its previously disclosed $15,000,000 rights offering.
Record date set for Sept. 25, 2026 to determine holders entitled to transferable subscription rights.
Rights allow purchase of up to 4,225,352 Class A shares in the aggregate at a set subscription price.
Subscription price will be the greater of $3.55 or the 15-day VWAP through the Record Date, providing a pricing floor.
Further offering details will be provided in a prospectus to be filed with the SEC when launched.
